The mapped_rxn from template_search gave mapped reaction with atom maps. We need to extract product SMILES (target) without mapping. The mapped_rxn is a reaction SMILES: reactants>>products. The product side after >> is product with mapping. We need to get product SMILES (target) without mapping. The product is after >>: "[O:1]=[N+:2]([O-:3])[C:4]1=[CH:5][N:6]=[C:7]([O:8][C:9]2=[CH:10][CH:11]=[CH:12][CH2:13][CH:14]([C:15]4=[CH:16][CH:17]=[CH:18][CH:19]=[CH:20]4)[CH2:21][O:22][C:23]3=[CH:24]2)[CH:25]=[CH:26]1". Wait there is a difference: In mapped_rxn product side includes [CH:12] vs earlier missing? The product side: ...[C:12][CH2:13]... Actually product side: ...[C:12][CH2:13]... The product SMILES includes atom maps. Need to strip them. Could use deprotect? Not needed. We can manually remove the mapping tags like ":1". So produce SMILES without mapping: remove all occurrences of :digit after atom symbol. Let's do that manually.

Now strip mapping: each atom like [O:1] becomes O, [N+:2] becomes [N+]? Keep charge. So [N+:2] -> [N+]. [O-:3] -> [O-]. [C:4] -> C. [CH:5] -> C? Actually [CH] indicates aromatic carbon with H? In SMILES, aromatic carbon is c. But [CH] is aliphatic carbon with H? Might be sp2 carbon. We'll keep as C? Might be okay. Simpler: remove colon and number, keep brackets content. So [CH:5] -> [CH]. That's okay.

Thus product SMILES (unmapped) = O=[N+]([O-])C1= C? Wait need to reconstruct.
